step1_analysis.circuit_type: Voltage-Limiting Precharge Switch / Charge-Injection-Cancelled Dynamic Load
step1_analysis.description: A clocked switch network that precharges the output node during one clock phase and limits the voltage swing during the evaluation phase to [|Vthp|, VDD-Vthn]. It uses parallel complementary-clocked transistors to cancel clock feedthrough and charge injection, maintaining a continuous signal path while halving the full-scale voltage range to conserve power.

v_out_max.description: Maximum output voltage during evaluation phase

sky130_expected.reasoning: The series NMOS passes high voltages but cuts off at VDD-Vthn. Body effect increases Vthn.

v_out_min.description: Minimum output voltage during evaluation phase

sky130_expected.reasoning: The series PMOS passes low voltages but cuts off at |Vthp|. Body effect increases |Vthp|.
The circuit halves the full-scale range to conserve power in the subsequent op-amps, as stated in the paper.

v_precharge_n2.description: Precharge voltage at output node during CLK=0

sky130_expected.reasoning: During CLK=0, N4 is pulled to VDD, and N2 is charged through the NMOS and PMOS, limited by the NMOS Vth.

glitch_pp.description: Peak-to-peak clock feedthrough glitch at output

sky130_expected.reasoning: The parallel NMOS and PMOS switches driven by opposite clocks cancel out most of the charge injection.
The 71mW reported is for the entire ADC. This single sub-block only drives small parasitic and load capacitances, consuming very little power.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC voltage limiting transfer characteristic and transient precharge/clock feedthrough.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Voltage-Limiting Switch
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCLK CLK 0 dc 1.8 pulse(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4.9n 10n)
VCLK_BAR CLK_BAR 0 dc 0 pulse(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4.9n 10n)

* DUT1 - Transient (Precharge and Clock Feedthrough)
XM1_t VDD CLK N4_t VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2_t N3_t CLK N4_t GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3_t N4_t CLK_BAR N3_t GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4_t N2_t CLK N3_t VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5_t N3_t CLK_BAR N2_t VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
C1_t N4_t 0 10f
C2_t N2_t 0 10f

* DUT2 - DC Sweep (Voltage Limiting Transfer Characteristic)
VN4_dc N4_dc 0 dc 0
XM1_dc VDD CLK N4_dc VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2_dc N3_dc CLK N4_dc GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3_dc N4_dc CLK_BAR N3_dc GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4_dc N2_dc CLK N3_dc VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5_dc N3_dc CLK_BAR N2_dc VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

.control
* DC Sweep
dc VN4_dc 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_out_max MAX v(N2_dc)
meas dc v_out_min MIN v(N2_dc)
let v_swing = v_out_max - v_out_min
print v_swing

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 20n
meas tran v_precharge_n4 FIND v(N4_t) AT=5n
meas tran v_precharge_n2 FIND v(N2_t) AT=5n
meas tran v_glitch_max MAX v(N2_t) FROM=5.9n TO=6.5n
meas tran v_glitch_min MIN v(N2_t) FROM=5.9n TO=6.5n
let glitch_pp = v_glitch_max - v_glitch_min
print glitch_pp

meas tran i_vdd_avg AVG i(VVDD) FROM=0 TO=20n
let power = -i_vdd_avg * 1.8
print power
quit
.endc
